# Better Pagbilao

> Better Pagbilao is a community-built, volunteer-run civic portal for Pagbilao, Quezon, Philippines. It gathers government services, hotlines, tourism information and public documents in one place. It is NOT an official government website and is not run by or affiliated with the Municipality of Pagbilao (LGU) or any government office. Always confirm requirements, fees and schedules with the responsible office.

Information on the site comes from public government documents and offices and remains the property of its original sources. Please credit the original source when you reuse it. Site content is in English, Tagalog and Taglish.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://betterpagbilao.org/): Overview of the portal and quick links
- [Hotlines](https://betterpagbilao.org/hotlines): Emergency and office contact numbers
- [Announcements](https://betterpagbilao.org/announcements): Public notices and updates
- [About our website](https://betterpagbilao.org/announcements/about-our-website): What Better Pagbilao is and who runs it

## Government

- [Legislative council](https://betterpagbilao.org/government/legislative-council): Sangguniang Bayan members
- [Local officials directory](https://betterpagbilao.org/government/local-officials-directory): Municipal officials and offices
